thread:
zoe: opened a tiny docs PR to add a quick Optimize checklist and two SDK snippets (py + node). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/821

harry: nice. can you make the Python snippet show both batching + pinning a quant profile? keeps it real for migrations.

zoe: yep. draft: 

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
# apply a throughput-first batching profile
client.optimize.apply_batching_profile(route='/summarize', profile='throughput')
# pin model alias to an int8 profile for evals
client.optimize.pin_quant_profile(model_alias='gptx-3', profile_name='int8-lite')
```

jia: looks good. small nit: add one sentence about running end-to-end evals after quant pinning and remind to have a canary on Dedicated before full rollout.

docs-bot: linkcheck: PR #821 0/02: ok. lint: warning - code fence language tag missing for the node snippet.

zoe: thanks, i'll add the node snippet with language tag and the eval note. also fixed a broken anchor on the caching section while I was at it (#caching-modes).

harry: can you include a one-liner on when to pick KV-prefix vs full-response caching? people always ask that.

zoe: added: "KV-prefix caching is best when many requests share an initial prompt prefix; full-response caching works for small, stable outputs." short and sweet.

jia: LGTM, approved. merging after CI green.

zoe: merged. leaving a follow-up to track adding a small perf plot example to the guide next sprint.
